title: Charles Vess
description: "Yoda was my favorite character," states Charles Vess. "I liked the organic touch of Yoda and the Jungle Planet in THE EMPIRE STRIKES BACK that contrasted the hard-edged technological aspect of the rest of the film." After working a short while in animation, Vess moved to New York City and becarne an official freelance artist. Some of his early work was for HEAVY METAL and NATIONAL LAMPOON; today he actively contributes to Marvel, DC and Dark Horse Comics.
